summary: Iteration 75: Confirmation-Gated Paper Trading - All 13 tests passed. Verified the 2-step order flow (place_paper_order_intent → confirm_paper_order) works correctly via chat endpoint. AI creates proposals with unique IDs (po_XXXXXXXX), validates cash/positions before proposal creation, and only executes trades after explicit user confirmation.
critical_code_review_comments: place_paper_order_intent (lines 235-291): Correctly validates cash for BUY and position for SELL before creating proposal. Returns error if validation fails.
confirm_paper_order (lines 294-322): Properly checks proposal exists and status is PENDING_CONFIRMATION before executing trade. Updates status to CONFIRMED after execution.
Portfolio agent tool definitions (lines 89-141): Well-structured OpenAI function calling schema with clear descriptions for place_paper_order_intent and confirm_paper_order.
PORTFOLIO_KEYWORDS regex (ai.py line 21-27): Correctly includes confirm|proposal|po_|order patterns to route confirmation messages to portfolio agent.
System prompt (lines 144-163): Clear instructions for AI to ALWAYS create proposal first, never execute directly, and only confirm after explicit user approval.
seed_data_creation: Admin account has existing positions: AAPL (5 shares), NVDA (3 shares), BTC (0.001), MSFT (varies due to test trades). Cash ~$90,000-96,000 (varies due to test trades).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 75 verified the confirmation-gated paper trading flow. Key flows tested: (1) 'buy X shares of Y' creates proposal with po_XXXXXXXX ID, does NOT execute immediately, (2) 'confirm po_XXXXXXXX' executes the trade and updates portfolio, (3) Insufficient cash returns error in proposal stage, (4) Sell validation checks position exists and quantity available, (5) Portfolio queries still work via get_portfolio_snapshot tool, (6) Non-portfolio queries use standard AI, (7) Manual paper trading endpoints (/api/paper/trade, /api/paper/portfolio) still work. MongoDB pending_orders collection stores proposals with status PENDING_CONFIRMATION → CONFIRMED.
